SELLER_STEPS.title: Get your valuation
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Enter your reg and details for a free, instant estimate.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Go live in auction
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Your car goes live for verified dealers to view and bid on.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Dealers compete
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Verified trade buyers bid against each other, not against you.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Dealer contacts you
SELLER_STEPS.desc: The winning dealer arranges collection and inspection directly.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Dealer pays you directly
SELLER_STEPS.desc: The money moves dealer → you. CarMazium is never in that chain.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Get your £100 reward
SELLER_STEPS.desc: After you confirm payment and your handover photo is approved, qualifying auction sales earn a £100 reward.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Search & find
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Filter by make, model, grade and location to shortlist cars.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Join the auction
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Only verified motor traders with bidding access can bid live in the dealer auction.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Win the auction
DEALER_STEPS.desc: The highest qualifying bid can win at close; a below-reserve offer requires seller acceptance.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Complete checkout
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Pay the standard £125 buyer fee unless an approved waiver applies; fee clearance unlocks seller contact.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Arrange collection
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Coordinate inspection and collection directly with the seller.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Drive with confidence
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Inspect, complete the handover, and it's yours.

rows.note: paid to you, by the dealer

SELLER_STEPS.title: List your vehicle for free
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Add vehicle details, photos and all known faults. Motor vehicles use registration-assisted entry. Touring caravans use manual details and at least one photo; no registration, VIN, mileage or year is required for a touring caravan.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Choose a private reserve
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Set the minimum price you are willing to accept. Bidders cannot see your reserve.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Let verified dealers bid
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Your approved listing enters a 24-hour auction. Late bids can extend the closing time.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Agree a successful sale
SELLER_STEPS.desc: A qualifying winning bid or an offer you explicitly accept below reserve can complete the auction. If no sale is agreed, you can relist.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Arrange the handover
SELLER_STEPS.desc: The winning dealer can contact you once the buyer fee is paid or an approved waiver applies. Arrange inspection and collection directly.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Receive payment directly
SELLER_STEPS.desc: The dealer pays you for the vehicle. Confirm receipt of the funds before releasing the vehicle and submitting handover evidence.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Receive the qualifying £100 incentive
SELLER_STEPS.desc: After a qualifying successful sale, confirmed payment and approved handover photo, CarMazium releases the £100 seller incentive through its payout process.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Complete dealer verification
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Use your existing Partner Account or create one if you are new. Verified motor traders can bid; ordinary retail customers cannot bid.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Find and review a vehicle
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Review the seller's photographs, declared faults and available vehicle history. Exterior grading is not a mechanical inspection.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Place a bid or request Buy It Now
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Bid in real time. If the seller offers Buy It Now, submit a request at that price; it is not an instant win and requires seller acceptance.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Wait for a confirmed win
BUYER_STEPS.desc: The highest qualifying bid can win when the auction closes. A below-reserve offer requires the seller's explicit acceptance.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Pay the standard £125 buyer fee
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Complete the buyer-fee checkout within the displayed 72-hour deadline, unless an approved fee waiver applies. This unlocks seller contact and chat; the fee is separate from the vehicle price.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Inspect and arrange collection
BUYER_STEPS.desc: After winning and fee clearance, use the purchase's linked inspection or delivery request where available. Agree collection and inspect the vehicle before handover.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Pay the seller and complete handover
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Pay the vehicle price directly to the seller. CarMazium does not collect or hold the vehicle purchase funds.

RULES.def: The initial auction window is 24 hours; late bids may extend it.
A qualifying bid in the final 3 minutes adds 3 minutes to the scheduled closing time. This can repeat.
The seller's minimum remains private. Below-reserve bids do not automatically complete a sale; the seller may explicitly accept a provisional offer.
The seller must accept the request before the earlier of 24 hours after the request or the auction closing time.
The standard £125 fee is charged after a confirmed win, subject to an approved fee waiver. It is separate from the vehicle price.
The £100 incentive is conditional on a qualifying completed sale and approved handover evidence.

TRUST.title: Verified trade buyers
TRUST.desc: Dealer bidding requires verification. Private buyers can use the retail marketplace.

TRUST.title: Seller-reported condition
TRUST.desc: Review declared faults and photographs. Exterior damage grades are based on reported damage, not independent mechanical checks. Touring caravans use seller-supplied details.

TRUST.title: Available vehicle history
TRUST.desc: Motor-vehicle listings show available MOT and registration information. History and disclosed condition do not guarantee a fault-free vehicle.

FAQS.q: Can a private individual sell at auction?
FAQS.a: Yes. Private sellers and motor traders can list for free. Only verified trade dealers can bid.

FAQS.q: What if my reserve is not met?
FAQS.a: There is no automatic sale. The seller may explicitly accept a provisional offer below reserve or relist if no sale is agreed.

FAQS.q: When do I receive the £100 incentive?
FAQS.a: After a qualifying successful sale, confirmation that the dealer paid you directly and approval of your handover photo. Payout is subject to the applicable terms.

FAQS.q: Does CarMazium hold the vehicle purchase price?
FAQS.a: No. Buyers pay sellers directly for vehicles. The auction buyer fee, seller incentive and separate paid TradeXchange services use their own payment processes.

FAQS.q: Can a winning dealer arrange an independent inspection?
FAQS.a: Where available, an eligible winning dealer can request a linked inspection after fee clearance and before approved handover. A completed linked inspection with faults recorded may allow refusal under the auction terms. The £125 buyer fee is refunded if paid; a waived fee has no cash refund.
Yes, where available. Use the linked delivery option on an eligible purchase to request transport quotes. Delivery is a separate paid service, not included in the auction fee.
